dogecoin.text: Some people may misunderstand my comments about #dogecoin. I don't hate $Doge, I trade it for profits. I buy it, sell it to make my money, and then buy in again when the time is right. However I don't believe it should be a HODL coin.

@g26383392 @InspecstarLLC @MikeDavisYT It is sad. The Dogecoin Army likes to tell me that I'm wrong but when I ask them to explain with facts, they can't. There is a reason why #doge pumped, dumped, and now is stationary at a low price.
@InspecstarLLC @g26383392 @MikeDavisYT I doubt you even know anything about Dogecoin and how the project works.

@ProTheDoge I think other cryptos will change the way we see money. Dogecoin has a fatal flaw that will cause it to fade way into the background. Unless this flaw is corrected it will go back to being the joke it was meant to be.
@MikeDavisYT If you wanted to change people's financial situations, you would be looking into more then just Dogecoin.

The #Dogecoin community idolized @elonmusk  like some sort of god, like he is going to save $DOGE. The only thing that will save Doge is a plan to cut the inflation, Doge won't hold it's value until fee burning or a hard cap is placed on the supply.
@pifinity My quote is 1 million Dogecoin and I'll come down and clean. 😃

@MikeDavisYT @MikeDavisYT ever wonder why #dogecoin won't break $.30?  It's because of the inflation problem has this is why I trade Dogecoin, I don't HODL it. Doge is good for making profits, it's not a good long term investment.

@pifinity Those people are probably going to sell when it hits that price.  I like dogecoin, I buy and sell it. But this is one of the reasons why I don't HODL it. There are people who could dump the market so fast. It's one of the realities of doge.

This is coming from @mcuban, the guy who invested in TITAN which floped. I wouldn't put much stock in what he has to say in the crypto world!!!! And @elonmusk should also stop playing with people's heads.

#dogecoin #Elonmusk
